mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% indicates labor market weakness, signaling potential earnings deterioration and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong manufacturing output, supporting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns during supply-driven expansions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 0.5% indicates monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) signal labor market deterioration, preceding negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines.

mechanism_narrative: Rising residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) during early-cycle expansion support earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, boosting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising.
